series.name: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)
series.notes: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit alarm codes + 2-digit aliases (Ed, U2, UE, U7, P6...) from CityMultiErrorCode_V4.pdf (official, high). Separate from PUCY file — model-scoped, never merged where digits diverge.

meaning.en: Communication between the outdoor controller board and the outdoor power board has failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor controller board aur outdoor power board ke darmiyan communication kharab ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Wire breakage or contact failure of connector CN2 or CN4
causes.ur: CN2 ya CN4 connector ki wire tooti hui ho ya contact na ban raha ho.

causes.en: Malfunction of the power-board communication circuit on the outdoor controller board
causes.ur: Outdoor controller board par power-board communication circuit theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Malfunction of the communication circuit on the outdoor power board
causes.ur: Outdoor power board par communication circuit kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check and re-seat connectors CN2 and CN4
solutions.ur: CN2 aur CN4 connectors check karein aur dobara theek se lagayein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle and re-read; replace the outdoor controller or outdoor power board if the fault persists
solutions.ur: Power cycle dein aur code dobara parhein; agar fault barqarar rahe to outdoor controller ya outdoor power board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: PUMY shows the 2-digit alias Ed on the check display.
notes.ur: PUMY check display par 2-digit alias Ed dikhata hai.

meaning.en: Compressor/discharge temperature is out of range — stop valve, refrigerant shortage, thermistor or LEV related.
meaning.ur: Compressor/discharge temperature range se bahar hai — stop valve, refrigerant kam, thermistor ya LEV se related.

causes.en: Malfunction of the stop valve, or overheated operation from refrigerant shortage
causes.ur: Stop valve kharab ho, ya refrigerant ki kami ki wajah se unit overheat ho kar chale.

causes.en: Defective thermistor, defective outdoor controller board, or LEV performance failure
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho, outdoor controller board kharab ho, ya LEV theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Clogged refrigerant system, or liquid accumulation in the compressor while indoor units are OFF
causes.ur: Refrigerant system block ho, ya indoor units band hone par compressor mein liquid jama ho jaye.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, check the refrigerant circuit/charge and inspect LEV operation
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, refrigerant circuit/charge check karein aur LEV ke kaam ko dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistors and replace the defective outdoor controller or indoor controller board as indicated
solutions.ur: Har thermistor ki resistance naapein aur jo outdoor controller ya indoor controller board kharab ho use badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: V4 gives 8 numbered causes for this code — the fullest single entry in the City Multi set.
notes.ur: V4 mein is code ke liye 8 numbered causes diye gaye hain — City Multi set mein sab se poori entry.

meaning.en: High pressure is out of range or the high-pressure detection circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: High pressure range se bahar hai ya high pressure detection circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Stop valve not fully open, clogged/broken pipe, or locked outdoor fan motor
causes.ur: Stop valve puri tarah khula na ho, pipe block/toota ho, ya outdoor fan motor atka ho jaye.

causes.en: Dirty outdoor heat exchanger, indoor short air cycle, clogged filter or locked indoor fan
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger ganda ho, indoor mein short air cycle ho, filter block ho ya indoor fan atka ho.

causes.en: Defective high-pressure sensor or its input circuit, indoor LEV or SV1 performance failure
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor ya uski input circuit kharab ho, ya indoor LEV/SV1 theek se kaam na kare.

solutions.en: Open the service valves, clean the heat exchangers/filters and confirm both fans run
solutions.ur: Service valves kholein, heat exchangers/filters saaf karein aur confirm karein ke dono fans chal rahe hain.

solutions.en: Compare the high-pressure sensor with gauge pressure and check LEV/SV1 operation
solutions.ur: High-pressure sensor ko gauge pressure se compare karein aur LEV/SV1 ka kaam check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: V4 lists 17 numbered causes — by far the most detailed high-pressure entry available.
notes.ur: V4 mein 17 numbered causes diye gaye hain — high-pressure ke liye yeh sab se tafseeli entry hai.

title.en: Superheat due to low discharge temperature
title.ur: Discharge temperature kam hone ki wajah se superheat

meaning.en: Discharge temperature is too low, giving abnormal superheat.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature bohat kam hai, jis se superheat abnormal ho gaya hai.

causes.en: TH4 disconnected, loose or its holder defective
causes.ur: TH4 khud juda ho, dhila ho ya uska holder kharab ho.

causes.en: LEV coil or LEV connector disconnected
causes.ur: LEV coil ya LEV connector khud juda ho gaya ho.

causes.en: LEV performance failure
causes.ur: LEV theek se kaam na kare.

solutions.en: Check and re-seat TH4 and its holder, then measure resistance
solutions.ur: TH4 aur uske holder ko check karke dobara theek se lagayein, phir resistance naapein.

solutions.en: Check the LEV coil/connector and LEV operation; correct refrigerant charge if needed
solutions.ur: LEV coil/connector aur LEV ka kaam check karein; agar zaroorat ho to refrigerant charge theek karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: Equivalent of Mr. Slim U7.
notes.ur: Yeh code Mr. Slim U7 ke barabar hai.

title.en: Refrigerant shortage / closed valve in cooling mode
title.ur: gys km hai ya oalo bnd hai

meaning.en: There is not enough refrigerant, or a liquid/gas valve is closed while cooling.
meaning.ur: Refrigerant kam hai, ya cooling ke dauran liquid/gas valve band ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Outdoor liquid/gas valve is closed
causes.ur: Outdoor liquid/gas valve band ho.

causes.en: Outdoor LEV (LEV-A) blocked
causes.ur: Outdoor LEV (LEV-A) block ho jaye.

causes.en: Gas leakage or shortage, defective thermistor or 63HS
causes.ur: Gas leak ya kami ho, thermistor kharab ho ya 63HS kharab ho.

solutions.en: Fully open the outdoor liquid and gas valves and confirm flow
solutions.ur: Outdoor liquid aur gas valves puri tarah kholein aur flow confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check LEV-A for blockage, leak-test and re-gas, then verify the thermistors and 63HS
solutions.ur: LEV-A mein blockage ke liye check karein, leak-test karke dobara gas bharein, phir thermistors aur 63HS verify karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: Two variants in V4: '<1601> (U2) refrigerant shortage' and '<1501> (U2) closed valve in cooling mode'.
notes.ur: V4 mein do versions hain: '<1601> (U2) refrigerant shortage' aur '<1501> (U2) cooling mode mein valve band'.

title.en: Freeze protection of branch box or indoor unit
title.ur: Branch box ya indoor unit ki freeze protection

meaning.en: Freeze protection has operated at the branch box or indoor unit, indicating a refrigerant distribution problem.
meaning.ur: Branch box ya indoor unit par freeze protection chali hai, jo refrigerant ki distribution mein kharabi dikhati hai.

causes.en: Wrong piping connection between indoor unit and branch box
causes.ur: Indoor unit aur branch box ke darmiyan piping connection galat ho.

causes.en: Mis-wiring between indoor unit and branch box
causes.ur: Indoor unit aur branch box ke darmiyan wiring galat ho.

causes.en: Mis-wired or malfunctioning LEV in the branch box or indoor unit
causes.ur: Branch box ya indoor unit mein LEV galat laga ho ya theek se kaam na kare.

solutions.en: Verify the piping connections and wiring between the indoor unit and branch box
solutions.ur: Indoor unit aur branch box ke darmiyan piping connections aur wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Check LEV wiring and operation in the branch box/indoor unit
solutions.ur: Branch box/indoor unit mein LEV ki wiring aur kaam check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias is P6 (same as Mr. Slim freeze/overheat). Present in V3; keep V3 as secondary reference.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias P6 hai (Mr. Slim freeze/overheat jaisa hi). Yeh V3 mein bhi hai; V3 ko secondary reference rakhein.

title.ur: Heating mode mein 4-way valve ki kharabi

meaning.en: The 4-way reversing valve is not switching correctly during heating.
meaning.ur: 4-way reversing valve heating ke dauran theek se switch nahi ho raha.

causes.en: 4-way valve failure
causes.ur: 4-way valve kharab ho jaye.

causes.en: Disconnection or failure of the 4-way valve coil
causes.ur: 4-way valve coil khud juda ho jaye ya fail ho jaye.

causes.en: Clogged drain pipe, loose connectors or defective outdoor power circuit board
causes.ur: Drain pipe block ho, connectors dhile hon ya outdoor power circuit board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the 4-way valve coil resistance and its connectors
solutions.ur: 4-way valve coil ki resistance aur uske connectors check karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the input circuit on the outdoor multi controller board and the outdoor power board
solutions.ur: Outdoor multi controller board aur outdoor power board par input circuit ko dekhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: New in V4 (was 1580 in V3) — heating-mode reverse-cycle faults.
notes.ur: Yeh V4 mein naya hai (V3 mein yeh 1580 tha) — heating-mode reverse-cycle faults.

meaning.en: A water leakage / lack-of-water-flow condition has been detected.
meaning.ur: Pani ka leakage ya pani flow na hone ki condition detect ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Water circuit flow problem (PWFY/heat-recovery contexts)
causes.ur: Water circuit ka flow masla ho (PWFY/heat-recovery cases mein).

causes.en: Drain path obstruction or pump issue at the indoor side
causes.ur: Drain path mein rukawat ho ya indoor side par pump ka masla ho.

solutions.en: Inspect the drainage and water circuit for blockages and confirm pump operation
solutions.ur: Drainage aur water circuit ko blockage ke liye dekhein aur pump ka kaam confirm karein.

solutions.en: Clear the fault and re-run; check for residual water before resetting
solutions.ur: Fault clear karein aur dobara chalayein; reset karne se pehle pani baqi ho to check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: S8 documents 2500 as 'Detecting lack of water flow on a water circuit' (R22/R410A columns) — confidence medium because the V4 entry is terse.
notes.ur: S8 mein 2500 ko 'water circuit mein flow ki kami ka pata lagana' (R22/R410A columns) likha hai — confidence medium hai kyunke V4 entry chhoti hai.

meaning.en: Water level was found in the drip tray during cooling — the drain is not clearing condensate.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke dauran drip tray mein pani ka level mila — drain condensate theek se nahi nikal raha.

causes.en: Drain pump failure or blocked drain/tray
causes.ur: Drain pump fail ho jaye ya drain/tray block ho.

causes.en: Float switch circuit fault (open/closed) on CN4F
causes.ur: CN4F par float switch circuit kharab ho (open/closed).

solutions.en: Check the drain pump, clear the drain and clean the filter
solutions.ur: Drain pump check karein, drain kholein aur filter saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the float switch connector CN4F and its open/closed resistance
solutions.ur: Float switch connector CN4F aur uski open/closed resistance check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias P5. S8 also documents 2503 (float sensor variant).
notes.ur: 2-digit alias P5 hai. S8 mein 2503 (float sensor wala version) bhi document hai.

title.ur: Compressor jam hone se current interruption

meaning.en: The compressor was interrupted because it is locked and cannot start.
meaning.ur: Compressor lock ho gaya hai aur start nahi ho sakta, is liye us ka kaam ruk gaya.

causes.en: Closed stop valve or decreased supply voltage
causes.ur: Stop valve band ho ya supply voltage kam ho jaye.

causes.en: Looseness, disconnection or reversed compressor wiring
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili ho, khuli ho ya ulti lage ho jaye.

causes.en: Incorrect DIP-SW model selection, defective compressor or defective outdoor power board
causes.ur: DIP-SW model selection galat ho, compressor kharab ho ya outdoor power board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, check the supply voltage and verify the compressor wiring
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, supply voltage check karein aur compressor ki wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Check the SW5 model-selection switches; test compressor windings and the outdoor power board
solutions.ur: SW5 model-selection switches check karein; compressor ki windings aur outdoor power board test karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias UF — same physical condition as Mr. Slim UF.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias UF — yeh wahi physical condition hai jo Mr. Slim UF mein hoti hai.

meaning.en: The indoor fan is not running as commanded.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor failure or obstruction
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor fail ho jaye ya koi rukawat ho.

causes.en: Wiring/connector fault or indoor board fault
causes.ur: Wiring/connector mein masla ho ya indoor board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the indoor fan motor, connector and airflow obstruction
solutions.ur: Indoor fan motor, connector aur airflow mein rukawat check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor or the indoor board after isolation
solutions.ur: Power isolate karne ke baad fan motor ya indoor board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias Pb — same as Mr. Slim PB.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias Pb — bilkul wahi hai jo Mr. Slim PB hai.

title.ur: Compressor overcurrent ya 12 VDC supply kharab

meaning.en: Overcurrent at the compressor, or the 12 VDC supply on the power board has failed.
meaning.ur: Compressor par zyada current, ya power board ki 12 VDC supply kharab hai.

causes.en: Closed outdoor stop valve or decreased supply voltage
causes.ur: Outdoor stop valve band ho ya supply voltage kam ho jaye.

causes.en: Loose/disconnected/reversed compressor wiring, malfunction of indoor/outdoor fan
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili/ulti ho, ya indoor/outdoor fan theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Model-selection error on board replacement, defective compressor or outdoor power board
causes.ur: Board change karne par model-selection galat ho jaye, compressor kharab ho ya outdoor power board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, check the supply voltage and re-terminate the compressor wiring
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, supply voltage check karein aur compressor ki wiring dobara theek se lagayein.

solutions.en: Verify the model-selection settings, then test the fans, compressor and outdoor power board
solutions.ur: Model-selection settings verify karein, phir fans, compressor aur outdoor power board test karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 9 numbered causes in V4.
notes.ur: V4 mein is ke 9 numbered causes hain.

title.en: Under/overvoltage, PAM or open phase fault
title.ur: Voltage kam ya zyada, PAM ya phase fault

meaning.en: Supply voltage is out of range, a phase is open, or the primary current sensor / synchronisation signal is faulty.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage range se bahar hai, koi phase open hai, ya primary current sensor / synchronisation signal kharab hai.

causes.en: Decrease or increase of power supply voltage (or L1 open-phase on Y models)
causes.ur: Power supply voltage kam ya zyada ho jaye (ya Y models mein L1 phase khula ho).

causes.en: Primary current sensor failure, disconnection of compressor wiring or CN2/CN5
causes.ur: Primary current sensor fail ho, compressor ki wiring khuli ho ya CN2/CN5 juda ho.

causes.en: Malfunction of the 52C relay or its driving circuit, defective outdoor power board
causes.ur: 52C relay ya uski driving circuit kharab ho, ya outdoor power board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Measure the supply voltage and correct it; check for open phase
solutions.ur: Supply voltage naapein aur theek karein; open phase ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Check CN2/CN5, the compressor wiring and 52C relay circuit, then re-read the code
solutions.ur: CN2/CN5, compressor ki wiring aur 52C relay circuit check karein, phir code dobara parhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 11 numbered causes in V4.
notes.ur: V4 mein is ke 11 numbered causes hain.

meaning.en: The inverter heat sink is overheating.
meaning.ur: Inverter heat sink zyada garm ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Blocked outdoor fan or blocked airflow path
causes.ur: Outdoor fan block ho jaye ya airflow path band ho.

causes.en: Malfunction of the outdoor fan motor or its driving circuit
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor ya uski driving circuit theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Rise in ambient temperature, or a defective thermistor
causes.ur: Ambient temperature barh jaye, ya thermistor kharab ho.

solutions.en: Clear the airflow path around the outdoor unit and check the fan motor
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ke ird-gird airflow path saaf karein aur fan motor check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor; replace the outdoor power board if the input circuit is faulty
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki resistance naapein; agar input circuit kharab ho to outdoor power board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 7 numbered causes in V4.
notes.ur: V4 mein is ke 7 numbered causes hain.

title.en: Power module trouble or overcurrent trouble

meaning.en: The power module or compressor overcurrent protection has tripped.
meaning.ur: Power module ya compressor ki overcurrent protection chali hai.

causes.en: Short-circuit caused by looseness or disconnection of compressor wiring
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili ya khuli hone ki wajah se short-circuit ho jaye.

causes.en: Defective compressor
causes.ur: Compressor kharab ho.

causes.en: Defective outdoor power circuit board
causes.ur: Outdoor power circuit board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Inspect and re-terminate the compressor wiring and measure winding resistance
solutions.ur: Compressor ki wiring ko dekhein, dobara theek se lagayein aur winding ki resistance naapein.

solutions.en: Test the inverter/compressor and replace the outdoor power board if the module has failed
solutions.ur: Inverter/compressor test karein aur agar module fail ho chuka ho to outdoor power board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 3 numbered causes in V4; preliminary code <4350>.
notes.ur: V4 mein is ke 3 numbered causes hain; preliminary code <4350>.

meaning.en: The outdoor fan motor is malfunctioning or its feedback is missing.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab chal raha hai ya us ka feedback nahi aa raha.

causes.en: Malfunction of the fan motor
causes.ur: Fan motor theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Disconnection of the CNF connector
causes.ur: CNF connector khud juda ho jaye.

causes.en: Defective outdoor multi controller circuit board
causes.ur: Outdoor multi controller circuit board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor fan motor and free any obstruction; check the CNF connector
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor check karein aur rukawat hata dein; CNF connector bhi check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor, or the outdoor multi controller board if the motor tests good
solutions.ur: Fan motor badlein, ya agar motor ki test theek aaye to outdoor multi controller board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias U8 — same as Mr. Slim U8.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias U8 — wahi hai jo Mr. Slim U8 mein aata hai.

title.en: Thermistor open/short — indoor and outdoor sensor family
title.ur: Thermistor open ya short ho gaya (PUMY)

meaning.en: An indoor or outdoor thermistor is open or shorted — TH21 air inlet, TH22 liquid pipe, TH23 gas pipe, TH4 discharge, TH6 suction, TH7 ambient, TH2 HIC pipe, TH3 outdoor liquid pipe, TH8 heat sink.
meaning.ur: Indoor ya outdoor ka koi thermistor open ya short ho gaya hai — TH21 air inlet, TH22 liquid pipe, TH23 gas pipe, TH4 discharge, TH6 suction, TH7 ambient, TH2 HIC pipe, TH3 outdoor liquid pipe, TH8 heat sink.

causes.en: Disconnection or contact failure of the connectors
causes.ur: Connectors khud juda hon ya contact na bane.

causes.en: Characteristic defect of the thermistor
causes.ur: Thermistor ki characteristic hi kharab ho.

causes.en: Defective outdoor multi controller circuit board
causes.ur: Outdoor multi controller circuit board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check and re-seat all listed connectors (indoor CN-side and outdoor controller board / CN6 on the power board)
solutions.ur: Sab listed connectors check karke dobara theek se lagayein (indoor CN-side aur outdoor controller board / power board par CN6).

solutions.en: Measure each thermistor's resistance and replace the thermistor or the controller board as indicated
solutions.ur: Har thermistor ki resistance naapein aur jo thermistor ya controller board kharab ho use badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: V4 spreads these over 5101/5102/5103/5105/5106/5109/5110 with aliases U3 (discharge/air inlet) and U4 (the rest) — always read the fault address to identify the exact sensor.
notes.ur: V4 inhein 5101/5102/5103/5105/5106/5109/5110 mein baant deta hai jinke aliases U3 (discharge/air inlet) aur U4 (baqi sab) hain — exact sensor ka pata lagane ke liye hamesha fault address dekhein.

meaning.en: The high-pressure sensor has failed or reports an implausible pressure.
meaning.ur: High pressure sensor kharab ho gaya hai ya ajeeb pressure bata raha hai.

causes.en: Defective high-pressure sensor
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor kharab ho.

causes.en: Internal pressure drop caused by gas leakage
causes.ur: Gas leak ki wajah se andar ka pressure girta ho.

causes.en: Connector contact failure or input-circuit fault
causes.ur: Connector ka contact na bane ya input circuit kharab ho.

solutions.en: Leak-test and repair, then compare the sensor reading with gauge pressure
solutions.ur: Leak-test karke leak theek karein, phir sensor ki reading gauge pressure se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the connector and the input circuit on the outdoor multi controller board
solutions.ur: Connector aur outdoor multi controller board par input circuit check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias F5 (same as Mr. Slim F5 / 63H).
notes.ur: 2-digit alias F5 hai (Mr. Slim F5 / 63H jaisa hi).

meaning.en: The current sensor on the outdoor power board reports an abnormal value.
meaning.ur: Outdoor power board par lage current sensor ghalat value de raha hai.

causes.en: Decrease or trouble of the power supply voltage
causes.ur: Power supply voltage kam ho jaye ya us mein masla ho.

causes.en: Disconnection of the compressor wiring
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring khud juda ho jaye.

causes.en: Input sensor trouble on the outdoor power circuit board
causes.ur: Outdoor power circuit board par input sensor mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Check the supply voltage and re-terminate the compressor wiring
solutions.ur: Supply voltage check karein aur compressor ki wiring dobara theek se lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power circuit board if the input sensor circuit has failed
solutions.ur: Agar input sensor circuit fail ho chuka ho to outdoor power circuit board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias UH — same as Mr. Slim UH.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias UH — bilkul wahi hai jo Mr. Slim UH hai.

title.en: Contact failure of drain float switch
title.ur: Drain float switch ka contact kharab

meaning.en: The drain float switch contact is not made correctly (disconnected or stuck).
meaning.ur: Drain float switch ka contact theek se nahi banta (disconnect ho gaya ya atak gaya hai).

causes.en: Float switch connector contact failure
causes.ur: Float switch connector ka contact na bane.

causes.en: Stuck or failed float switch
causes.ur: Float switch atka ho jaye ya fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the float switch connector and its open/closed resistance
solutions.ur: Float switch connector aur uski open/closed resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the float switch or the indoor board if the switch tests incorrectly
solutions.ur: Agar switch ki test galat aaye to float switch ya indoor board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: Detected on the indoor unit side; 2-digit alias P4.
notes.ur: Yeh indoor side par detect hota hai; 2-digit alias P4.

meaning.en: Two or more controllers (outdoor, indoor, Fresh Master, Lossnay or remote) share the same address.
meaning.ur: Do ya zyada controllers (outdoor, indoor, Fresh Master, Lossnay ya remote) ka address aik hi hai.

causes.en: Duplicate address assignment
causes.ur: Address dobara set ho jaye, duplicate ho jaye.

causes.en: Noise interference on indoor/outdoor connectors
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor connectors par noise interference ho.

solutions.en: Re-assign unique addresses and power-cycle the system
solutions.ur: Har unit ko unique address dein aur system ka power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Check connectors for noise and clear the error after correction
solutions.ur: Connectors mein noise ke liye check karein aur theek karne ke baad error clear karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: 2-digit alias A0.
notes.ur: Is code ka 2-digit alias A0 hai.

title.ur: Connecting unit ki tadaad mein ghalti (PUMY)

meaning.en: More indoor units or branch boxes are connected than the PUMY outdoor unit allows.
meaning.ur: PUMY outdoor unit ki ijazat se zyada indoor units ya branch boxes lage hue hain.

causes.en: More than the limit: up to 12 indoor units and 2 branch boxes
causes.ur: Limit se zyada: 12 indoor units aur 2 branch boxes tak.

causes.en: No indoor unit connected at all
causes.ur: Koi indoor unit juda hi nahi hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect units to bring the count within the limits (minimum 1 indoor unit)
solutions.ur: Units ko disconnect karke tadaad limit ke andar le aayein (kam se kam 1 indoor unit).

solutions.en: Re-read the code after a full power cycle
solutions.ur: Poora power cycle karne ke baad code dobara parhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: V4 gives the exact numeric limits for PUMY — useful when a PK install is expanded beyond capacity.
notes.ur: V4 mein PUMY ke exact numeric limits diye gaye hain — jab PK install ki capacity se aage barhaya jaye to kaam aate hain.

meaning.en: An indoor unit that is not authorised for this outdoor unit has been connected.
meaning.ur: Aisay indoor unit lage hue hain jo is outdoor unit ke sath authorized nahi hain.

causes.en: Connecting indoor unit(s) not authorised for the outdoor unit
causes.ur: Jo indoor unit jude hain woh outdoor unit ke liye allowed hi nahi hain.

causes.en: Wrong model/capacity code set on the indoor board
causes.ur: Indoor board par model/capacity code galat set ho.

solutions.en: Remove or replace the incompatible indoor unit
solutions.ur: Jo indoor unit match nahi kar raha use hata dein ya badal dein.

solutions.en: Correct the capacity code (SW2) and re-read after a power cycle
solutions.ur: Capacity code (SW2) theek karein aur power cycle ke baad code dobara parhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

notes.en: S8: 'Incompatible equipment on M-Net — check split with MAC-399 wired onto the TB5 line'.
notes.ur: S8: 'M-Net par incompatible equipment — MAC-399 ko TB5 line par lagakar split check karein'.
